title: LLM compression measurements: lossless and lossy compression on top of existing KV-cache and weight formats (RTX 3090, llama.cpp)
description: Measurements of how much compression can be added on top of the KV-cache formats (F16, Q8_0, Q4_0) and weight formats (BF16, Q8_0, Q4_K_M) used by llama.cpp, on one RTX 3090. A measurement study with mostly negative results; no new method is proposed. Includes the paper, all measurement records (R1-R87), llama.cpp patches, scripts and result summaries. All speed windows were shared with desktop applications; server-GPU rows are analytic projections.
